name: Goodly Folk
summary: Living folk who prevail by lending hands, arms, and courage to whoever stands nearby.
playstyle: Neighbor-focused skills and formation play reward careful adjacency and a line that supports itself.

name: Bone Host
summary: The dead return, multiply, and endure after a reasonable company would have fallen.
playstyle: Respawn, death triggers, and flanking effects turn losses and awkward angles into pressure.

name: Belowborn
summary: Dwarfs count the coin; deep beasts spend it. A Belowborn company grows slowly and arrives heavy.
playstyle: Economy-minded dwarfs build toward weightier recruits and patient board development.
